column1: # US 4,325,121 FIG. 19A/19B (Sheets 29-30) - PLA check of the lines of FIG. 18
# DBcc (0101 cccc 11 001 rrr): no line of the 0101 group (13,14,15,16) has bubbles on IRD5/4/3;
#   the only lines with bits 5/4/3 are 41 (cmpm), 37/35/33/31 (shift) and 10/5/4 (abcd,sbcd,addx,subx).
#   DBcc activates exactly the same lines as Scc: 14 (7 6) + 15 (8) or 16 (8') depending on IRD8,
#   but 15 and 16 are inhibited by 14 ((14) i) -> only the rows inhibited by 14 remain = rows 1..14, only row 15 stays free.
